title: Concept: Trace collector address disclosed
description: An OTLP exporter configured with an internal collector host and port in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The collector host names internal topology, and reachability to it is often unauthenticated inside the perimeter, so the address is a pivot target for anyone reading the page.
applicability: Deployments that render an OTLP exporter configured with an internal collector host and port into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The collector host names internal topology, and reachability to it is often unauthenticated inside the perimeter, so the address is a pivot target for anyone reading the page.
